Name: Department of Energy and Water Bills DEWB
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[url=https://ibb.co/Fmg2Gw9][img]https://i.ibb.co/hLDbpWk/Mod-Cover.png[/img][/url]

[size=4]Adds weekly utilities bill for an extra challenge and for those who have too much money in their hands.
The weekly bill will arrive in the mail every Thursday, festivals won't save you.[/size]

(Day can change with the config!)


[size=2]If you don't have enough money it will take what it can, and if you end up with 0 by the night maybe something might happen...
Also please don't ignore the Billing or the Collections Department from Ferngill's Department of Energy and Water, you might invoke their wrath.
[/size]
In other words, check your mailbox.

Calculations were made using buildings built, farmhouse upgrades, and some very arbitrary numbers to take into account weather, crops and production (looking at you, you wine tycoons). Your little farm in Ginger Island isn't safe from the billing either!

[I am not a math person so if it's not balanced enough I won't be making any changes to the mess of a calculation I made - only if its too crazy]



[size=3]Version 1.2![/size]
Furniture piece sold by Robin (for 5000g) which helps you see the different parameters that get seen in your bill >< 
Now requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img][/url]

[size=2]Shouldn't have any compatibility issues.[/size]
Can most definitely work with Airyn's[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29309] Simple Electricity Bill
[/url]Go wild with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24357]Serfdom[/url] and other tax mods.

Should be ok for multiplayer, just make sure to check and coordinate the config.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/3vBx7vz/configuration.png[/img][/url]
[size=1]Make sure to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] so you can check your configs easier~
Read carefully![/size]

[spoiler]
[size=3]--Maths--[/size]
[b]Base Multiplier:[/b] Change some of the difficulty :3
('Easy x1' by default)

[b]Challenge Mode:[/b] Challenging from the start, and I am not telling you by how much... (Should choose if you want to grind late game)
(Definite crazier maths so I recommend trying the "Base Multiplier: More Challenge" option before you delve into this)
('false' by default)

[size=3]--Mode--[/size]
[b]End of Grace Period: [/b]Choose when you want your grace period to end, between Summer 28 or Winter 28 of Year 1.
('Summer 28' by default)

[b]Day for Weekly Bill:[/b] Choose the day of the week you want to receive your weekly bill, between Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
('Thursday' by default)

[b]Day for Monthly Service Bill:[/b] Choose the day of the month you want to receive your service bill, between 26, 27, and 28.
('28' by default)

[b]Day for Winter Surcharge Bill:[/b] Choose the day of the week you want to receive your weekly winter surcharge bill, between Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
('Wednesday' by default)

[b]Multiplayer Players:[/b] If you are not using separate wallets in multiplayer, select the amount of players.
('1' by default)

[b]Profit Margin Change:[/b] If you are using the profit margin changes from the vanilla game, you can change this config to match it!.
('100%' by default)
[/spoiler]
